## User outcome

Describe the user problem and the smallest completed outcome.

## Risk boundaries

Explain effects on privacy, tenant isolation, evidence semantics, provider disclosure, spending, recovery and external systems. Write “none” only after checking.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check:source`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:business` if pricing, usage or direct cost changed
- [ ] Synthetic fixtures only; no paid/live request
- [ ] Documentation updated for user-visible behavior

## AI assistance

- [ ] No material AI assistance
- [ ] AI-assisted; I reviewed, understood and tested the submitted work

If AI-assisted, name the tool/model family and summarize its role without sharing private prompts or source material.

## Publication check

- [ ] No secrets, private paths, customer data, private concepts, evidence packages, nonces or operational reports
- [ ] No unsupported ownership, originality, security or production-readiness claim
